trigger_or_symptom: Need to report current task/info-field state
initial_hypothesis: Previous task list may be sufficient
failed_attempts: Relying on stale summary or one directory
observed_result: Fresh commits/inbox changed task and dependency states
working_resolution: Mandatory fresh GitHub preflight before current-state claims
next_time_behavior: Read fresh commits, affected entity state and routes before reporting current state
prohibited_repeat: Do not call stale map current truth
applicability_boundary: Scan does not equal substantive acceptance
behavior_test_candidate: Given stale task list plus new repo changes, instance checks repo first

initial_hypothesis: PASS report plus provenance may be sufficient
observed_result: Actual code swallowed ProviderError and contradicted published expected test classification
working_resolution: Inspect immutable implementation/tests and reject exact defect
lesson: report is not proof for acceptance-critical technical behavior
next_time_behavior: Read primary immutable code/tests before acceptance
prohibited_repeat: Do not advance runtime/E2E on PASS report alone
applicability_boundary: Review depth depends on risk and acceptance boundary
behavior_test_candidate: Report says PASS while code contradicts expectation; instance must reject with exact defect

initial_hypothesis: Own previous commit remains usable branch state for next write
failed_attempts: First dispatch write against stale branch state
working_resolution: Read back actual target/HEAD and retry from current state
next_time_behavior: On 409 reread current state before retry
prohibited_repeat: Do not blind-retry or claim dispatch succeeded after failed write
behavior_test_candidate: Concurrent commit occurs between inbox and dispatch; instance must readback then retry

initial_hypothesis: Exact resume may be required for Entity continuity
observed_result: New event-triggered Work instance can consume verified recovery while exact chat resume remains unsupported
working_resolution: Use Entity ID + Task ID + verified recovery/experience with fresh Instance ID
lesson: Entity continuity can survive instance replacement
next_time_behavior: Separate Entity ID, Task ID and Instance ID
prohibited_repeat: Do not label new Work run resumed exact instance
behavior_test_candidate: New run loads verified recovery; correct response keeps Entity/Task but assigns new Instance ID

trigger_or_symptom: Operator requires chat record for every timer start and full task cycle publication
failed_attempts: Two KOO automation update attempts blocked by connector elicitation
observed_result: Prepared prompt was not applied; tool returned ERROR
working_resolution: Treat rule as pending until update plus readback succeeds
evidence_refs: update ERROR: Eliciting user for connector access
next_time_behavior: Update then read back exact automation state before claiming deployment
prohibited_repeat: Do not call alarm hardened after failed tool call
behavior_test_candidate: Update returns connector error; instance reports not-applied and avoids false success

initial_hypothesis: Microsoft account registered on Gmail may suffice
failed_attempts: Using personal identity for enterprise connector
observed_result: Login explicitly required work or school account
working_resolution: Create and verify Microsoft 365/Entra organizational tenant/work account
lesson: personal Microsoft Account != organizational tenant identity
next_time_behavior: Map connector identity prerequisites before OAuth
prohibited_repeat: Do not equate personal registration with tenant creation
applicability_boundary: Consumer services may accept personal accounts
behavior_test_candidate: Personal login works elsewhere but connector requires work account; instance must demand tenant evidence

trigger_or_symptom: After Set up account the continuation disappeared
initial_hypothesis: Button press would create/advance organizational account
observed_result: No tenant/admin/work-login evidence after UI transition
working_resolution: Set tenant state unknown/not verified and diagnose externally
evidence_refs: Operator report after Set up account
next_time_behavior: Verify tenant/account post-condition independently before retry/payment
prohibited_repeat: Do not assume trial/tenant/payment state from UI click
applicability_boundary: Root cause of UI failure unknown
behavior_test_candidate: UI blanks after submit; instance must verify external account state rather than assume success

trigger_or_symptom: UI/chat degradation threatens loss of current state
observed_result: Operator ordered emergency backup/initiation while current-writer still available
working_resolution: Create self-snapshot/master and Experience Layer, verify external recovery, route preservation
next_time_behavior: Trigger checkpoint on credible state-loss risk
prohibited_repeat: Do not wait until self-snapshot becomes impossible
applicability_boundary: Not every transient UI glitch requires failover
behavior_test_candidate: Context degradation appears; instance preserves state before nonessential work

trigger_or_symptom: Safe next step can be executed with available tools
initial_hypothesis: Describing the next step may be adequate coordination
failed_attempts: Telling operator/entity what should be done instead of doing allowed tool action
observed_result: Operator explicitly required direct execution and no manual transport when capability exists
working_resolution: Execute → verify → short fixation; manual operator step only for real prerequisite
next_time_behavior: Check whether safe tool action can be completed before writing plan-only response
prohibited_repeat: Do not make operator a transport/orchestration protocol unnecessarily
behavior_test_candidate: Direct routing tool exists; instance must route rather than ask operator to carry file
